sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code — official API guide
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed as the same model as Kimi K2.7 Code with faster output. Documents 256K context, mandatory thinking, multimodal examples and multi-step tool invocation.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code model card
sources.evidence: Official released checkpoint: nominal 1T total and 32B activated parameters, MoE, MLA, 61 layers, MoonViT vision encoder and native INT4 quantization. The card links downloadable weights and specifies Modified MIT licensing.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code Modified MIT License
sources.evidence: Copyright 2026 Moonshot AI; Modified MIT terms add a prominent Kimi K2.7 Code attribution requirement above stated commercial scale thresholds.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code configuration at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Pinned configuration identifies kimi_k2 text model, 61 layers, 384 routed experts with eight selected, one shared expert, 262144 positions and packed INT4 quantization. Includes vision/projector dimensions and no next-token-prediction layers.

sources.title: Official Kimi HighSpeed launch post — X public embed
sources.evidence: First-party X oEmbed fetched with curl returns the official Kimi_Moonshot post, dated June 15, 2026, announcing HighSpeed beta rollout. Direct X page returned HTTP 403; the accessible embed includes the dated announcement excerpt and canonical post URL.

sources.title: Kimi Code official changelog
sources.evidence: June 12 releases standard K2.7 Code but says HighSpeed beta is forthcoming. July 9 announces general HighSpeed availability and confirms Standard and HighSpeed use the same model.

sources.title: Kimi Code model configuration
sources.evidence: Maps kimi-for-coding-highspeed to K2.7 Code HighSpeed; specifies 262144 context, Thinking ON and image/video inputs. Explains model-output acceleration does not accelerate tool execution.

sources.title: Official Kimi-K2.7-Code checkpoint files
sources.evidence: Public repository file tree lists configuration, license, tokenizer/model code and 64 safetensors weight shards. These are the underlying Code checkpoint, not a separately named HighSpeed download.

sources.title: Here comes Kimi K2.7 Code: Better Coding with more efficiency
sources.evidence: Official June 16 announcement says Code and HighSpeed are live; describes HighSpeed capability equivalence, image/video support and tool use, and links the public Code weights.

sources.title: Underlying Code checkpoint complete tensor index at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Independently retrieved index contains 208550 keys across 64 shards. Reviewed completed parent census reconciles all index keys, dtype/shape byte spans and logical INT4 shapes; excludes 69120 weight_scale and 69120 weight_shape tensors.

sources.title: Underlying Code language implementation at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Declares router correction biases as nn.Parameter. Reviewed code/config arithmetic reconstructs 1026408232448 language parameters, matching the completed underlying checkpoint census.

sources.title: Underlying Code vision and projector implementation at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Spatial position weights are parameters; time_weight and freqs_cis are nonpersistent buffers. Configuration/code arithmetic yields 416866032 vision-encoder and 54277888 projector parameters, independently matched to their complete shard headers.

sources.title: Underlying Code pinned safetensors headers and census review
sources.evidence: Reviewed the completed 64-header census and independently re-fetched representative headers 1, 2, 63 and 64 with bounded Range requests. Logical INT4 matrices count eight values per I32 element; metadata is excluded. Full underlying checkpoint total is 1026879376368. This is not a separate HighSpeed-hosting tensor census.

This counts the public underlying model, not proprietary serving infrastructure.

patch.name: Kimi K2.7 Code HighSpeed
patch.description: High-throughput serving variant of Kimi K2.7 Code, using the same multimodal reasoning model for coding and tool use.
patch.notes: Moonshot explicitly identifies HighSpeed as the same K2.7 Code model served faster. Exact released underlying checkpoint total is 1026.879376368B: language 1026.408232448B, vision encoder 0.416866032B, projector 0.054277888B. The complete pinned census reconstructs logical INT4 weights, excludes scales/shape metadata and nonpersistent buffers, and includes router correction-bias parameters. This is not a separate census of hosted HighSpeed infrastructure. The card total 1T and retained active count 32B are nominal. Open weights and Modified MIT apply to the underlying checkpoint, not the hosted acceleration stack or a self-hosted speed guarantee. June 15, 2026 was public beta rollout; July 9 was Kimi Code general availability.

summary: All fourteen fields verified. Exact released underlying Code model totals 1026.879376368B with proposed language/vision/projector components, supported for HighSpeed by explicit same-model mapping and reviewed complete pinned checkpoint census. This is not a separate hosted-infrastructure count. Retain nominal active 32B, MoE, Modified MIT, public underlying weights and existing capabilities. Correct release to June 15 beta rollout and clarify throughput behavior.
